categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Modifies the libbitcoinkernel C and C++ public API files (`src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h`, `bitcoinkernel.cpp`, `bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h`) and kernel tests.
categories.rationale: Fixes an O(n^2) algorithmic regression in `btck_witness_stack_get_item_at` introduced by #36895 by caching parsed witness item spans. While it corrects quadratic traversal for consumers reading witness stacks, witness sizes are typically modest and libbitcoinkernel's API is still evolving.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Despite the Validation label, changes are strictly confined to the libbitcoinkernel C/C++ API wrappers (`src/kernel/bitcoinkernel*`) without altering consensus or node validation logic.
categories.rationale: The category explicitly excludes changes whose primary subject is the kernel library API.
